description: A locally patched native harness accepted a per-pixel R8 mask with valid=255 and hole=0.
host_control_masked_definition: valid pixels select simple RightPrefilledColor; HoleMask pixels select native DLSS5 output
conclusion: The mask-file path was accepted by the temporary harness but had no observable effect in this native runtime/add-on combination. The working stereo pipeline therefore applies the same mask semantics at the host composite boundary; this preserves valid pixels and improves the planar oracle all-pixel MAE to 0.00862.
